cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Admit You’re Hurt
cards.instruction: Get someone to admit hurt, fear, or disappointment before you reveal that you feel it too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Did the boss calling us office furniture hurt you?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why? Are you making a complaint?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. It's still in drafts. How did you feel?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Invisible. I've worked here twelve years.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Me too. Mine says 'unprofessional'; I'm changing that to 'I went home and cried.'

mechanism: A trains its former office pupil to name personal impact before allowing that pupil admission to draw out A own hurt.
confusable: Not gathering complaint facts alone: A withholds its personal feeling until B says how it felt.
